pages.title: Bus Jam : Sort Escape
pages.creator: YIGOT
pages.description:
Untangle a crowded road in Bus Jam : Sort Escape by sending buses to collect passengers of the same color. Every departure uses limited road space, so choose the order carefully and combine three matching buses into a double-decker to help clear the traffic.

The puzzle has 1,000 levels, with Clear, Shuffle, and Magnet boosters available when the arrangement gets difficult. Click or tap buses and buttons to make your moves. As you advance, you can unlock pixel-art collections, and your progress is saved in the browser you are using.

pages.title: Panda Restaurant
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Run a panda's forest restaurant in Panda Restaurant, a management game about building up your business and increasing its income. You take charge of the restaurant as it grows, balancing the work of running it with the time-management challenges along the way. Tap or drag to interact with the game and guide your panda through the restaurant adventure.

pages.title: Cars with Guns: Wasteland Showdown
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Cars with Guns: Wasteland Showdown sends you into a post-apocalyptic landscape in an armed vehicle. Accept contracts, collect loot, and earn money and reputation while fighting your way through the wasteland. Driving and shooting are separate actions, so you can control your position as you attack.

Use D or the right arrow to drive forward, A or the left arrow to reverse, and Space to brake. Click or tap an enemy for an aimed shot, or press Enter to use auto-aim shooting.

pages.title: Arrow Tap Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Clear the grid in Arrow Tap Puzzle by selecting arrows whose paths lead out of the board without being blocked. Look along each arrow's direction before choosing it: an invalid selection costs a life, while removing an available arrow can open a route for another.

Work through each arrangement until the board is empty. Hints can reveal a move when you get stuck, and daily challenges add fresh puzzles alongside the level progression.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Wild West
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Join Sheriff Bonnie in Bubble Shooter Wild West and keep a growing stack of colored bubbles away from the bottom of the screen. Aim the cannon to connect at least three bubbles of one color and remove them. The display shows both your current bubble and the next shot, helping you choose where to aim.

Misses count as fouls, and exhausting the grey bubbles brings in another row. Use the Swap booster to change your shot or a Fireball to break through obstacles. Novice, Expert, and Master modes track your current, previous, and best scores.

pages.title: Gloves of Block
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description:
Guard your country's goal in Gloves of Block, a football game played from the goalkeeper's position. Choose a national team, then drag the gloves with your mouse or finger to meet incoming shots and stop the ball from reaching the net.

Each match asks you to make a required number of saves before conceding too many goals. Those targets depend on the strength of both teams, and stronger opponents make the later matches tougher. Win your way through the competition toward the World Cup trophy.

pages.title: Flower Collection
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description:
Sort flowers by color in Flower Collection. Select accessible flowers from the layered board and send them into matching collection slots. Each target needs three flowers of its color, while flowers without a matching destination occupy limited waiting spaces.

Clear the required flowers to finish the board, and avoid filling the waiting area with colors you cannot use. Flowers covered by higher layers are blocked, so check which pieces you can remove and which destinations still have room before selecting one.

pages.title: Team Loyalty
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Start with one runner and build a crowd in Team Loyalty. Steer through numbered gates to increase your group, avoid obstacles, and reach encounters with enough people to outnumber the opposition. The route you choose affects the size of the team you bring into battle.

Swipe left or right with the mouse, or use the same finger movement on the screen, to guide your characters between gates and hazards.

pages.title: Digit Shooter
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Digit Shooter turns a green number into the focus of a shooting runner. Fire at green numbers and numbered walls, then collect what you can to increase your own number as you advance. Red walls are obstacles to avoid, so keep your shots directed toward useful targets.

At the finish, concentrate your fire along one line to collect more rewards. Click or tap to play as you work toward a larger number and a better result.

pages.title: Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description:
Travel through a fantasy world of elves, dwarfs, and mermaids in Tri Peaks Emerland Solitaire. Remove cards by choosing one that is a single rank above or below the current card. If there is no available move, draw from the deck to change the card you are playing on.

Build longer combinations to earn more stars, and aim to remove every card from the field. Clearing the whole layout is also required for a three-star result. Click or tap the cards and interface to play.

pages.title: Magic Kingdom. Hex Match
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Build a kingdom through resource puzzles in Magic Kingdom. Hex Match. Playing as a king's third son sent away to prove himself, you gather food, water, stone, wood, workers, and metal to construct buildings and unlock further structures.

Drag stacks of hexagonal tiles onto the field and arrange them so the tiles on top match. The matching puzzle supplies the resources for your growing settlement, linking each placement to the next stage of construction.

pages.title: Grow Castle Defence
pages.creator: Visual Dream Games
pages.description:
Grow Castle Defence puts swordsmen and archers between your castle and increasingly strong enemies. Defeat attackers to earn coins, then spend them on stronger soldiers and a faster income rate. Improving both your front line and your archers helps prepare the defense for later levels.

A boss appears every five levels and offers extra money when defeated. New abilities become available during progression, adding effects to the battles. Use the mouse to select upgrades and interact with the game.

pages.title: Hill Climbing Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Tackle uneven tracks in Hill Climbing Mania and get your car from the start to the finish of each level. Hills and obstacles make the journey more than a straight drive: you can attempt flips and other tricks for bonuses, but you need to keep the car under control.

Gather coins to upgrade your vehicles, collect stars to complete more of each level, and pick up helpful items along the route. Upgrades support your next attempts at the hilly courses.

pages.title: Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Sorcerer Mahjong Marvels is a timed tile-matching game with magical artifacts decorating the board. Select pairs of matching tiles that are open at the sides, removing available pieces until you have collected every set. Clearing one pair can make other tiles available, so inspect the layout as it changes.

The game contains 60 levels to finish within their time limits. Click or tap to select tiles, use a hint when you need help spotting a match, or obtain extra time to continue clearing a board.

pages.title: Portal TD - Tower Defense
pages.creator: f-igri.ru
pages.description: Stop creatures emerging from an open portal in Portal TD - Tower Defense. Use defensive towers to hold back the attackers and protect your position against their advance. Interact with your defenses using either the mouse or the touchscreen.

pages.title: My Farm life
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Take charge of crops, animals, and farm expansion in My Farm life. Plant fields and harvest produce such as apples, wheat, tomatoes, and eggplants, while raising animals for farm products including milk and eggs. Slide to move around and carry out the work.

As the farm develops, you can hire workers and build larger barns. Growing crops and caring for livestock give you several parts of the farm to manage as you work toward a bigger business.

pages.title: ZombCopter
pages.creator: Phone Software Kft.
pages.description:
Defend the last intact City Hall from a zombie horde in ZombCopter. Fight from an armed helicopter, fire into approaching waves, and choose upgrades to strengthen your response as the attack continues. The objective is to keep the building standing against the endless assault.

Move with WASD, fire with the left mouse button, and use the right button for the weapon's secondary function. R reloads, while the number keys or mouse wheel switch weapons. Press L to release the cursor and open the pause menu.

pages.title: Lifting Hero
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Build up a weightlifter in Lifting Hero, starting with small dumbbells and working toward heavier objects. Click repeatedly to lift, develop muscle, and improve your lifting speed. You can exchange the muscle you have earned for new equipment, then continue training with larger weights. Progress comes from repeating that cycle of lifting, trading, and taking on a heavier load.

pages.title: Air Traffic Controller
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Keep the skies organized in Air Traffic Controller by guiding planes and helicopters to their appropriate landing areas. Set safe routes for the incoming aircraft and watch the traffic around them so their paths do not lead to a collision. Every aircraft needs to reach the correct destination safely, making the timing and spacing of your routes central to the task.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet Rampage
pages.creator: DAPALAB
pages.description:
Fight an army of hostile toilets and their bosses in Skibidi Toilet Rampage. Move around each encounter and use your attack or dash to take on the enemies standing in your way. Boss battles bring tougher confrontations as you advance through the levels.

On a keyboard, move with WASD and press Space to attack or dash. With the on-screen joystick, drag in a direction to move and tap the joystick to perform the action.

pages.title: Spider Swing Manhattan
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Swing through the city in Spider Swing Manhattan by firing a web, holding on to build your swing, and releasing to fly toward the next attachment point. Your aim is to travel as far as possible without falling or striking a dangerous obstacle. Tap and hold to stay connected, then let go when you are ready to launch across the next gap.

pages.title: Up and Down Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Up and Down Colors Game gives you two directions to choose from as obstacles block your path. Move up or down to find a clear route and keep the run going. A single collision ends the attempt, so each decision depends on spotting the obstacle ahead and changing direction in time.

pages.title: Liquid Sort
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description:
Separate mixed colors in Liquid Sort by pouring liquid between test tubes until each tube contains a single color. Empty tubes give you room to move colors around while you reorganize the others, so consider where a pour will leave space for your next move.

Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard before entering the levels. Tap the tubes to make your selections and work through the arrangement one color at a time.

pages.title: Filling Lines
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Filling Lines asks you to connect matching shapes across a puzzle board. Click and drag to draw a line from one tile to its matching partner, then work out how the remaining pairs should connect to complete the arrangement. The order of your connections matters, so look at the whole puzzle before committing to a route.

pages.title: Mr. Superfire
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Jump through enemy fire and fight back in Mr. Superfire, a shooting game built around surviving enemy encounters and improving your arsenal. Shoot attackers, avoid their bullets, and collect coins to unlock weapons or upgrade the ones you have.

Perks add further help as you progress through more than 60 levels. Each attempt gives you another chance to work on your movement and get farther through the fights.

pages.title: Gummy Blocks Battle
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:
Compete against another player in Gummy Blocks Battle by completing horizontal or vertical lines of blocks. Clearing lines gives you more time, while removing two or more together sends locks to obstruct your opponent's board.

You need to keep your own board moving while looking for opportunities to interfere with the other player. A move that completes several lines at once can therefore help both your time reserve and your attack.

pages.title: Tactical Princess
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Help the princesses prepare for a paintball tournament in Tactical Princess. The game combines a memory challenge with choosing their equipment and putting together tactical outfits for the match. Work on remembering what you need as you collect the gear and help the girls get ready. Use the left mouse button or touch controls to make your selections.

pages.title: Feed the Panda
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Use rope-cutting physics to deliver food in Feed the Panda. Decide which rope to cut so the suspended food can fall or swing toward the panda, then choose the next cut with its movement in mind. The goal is to feed the waiting animal by turning the arrangement of ropes into a workable path.

pages.title: Stickman Bridge
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Race toward the finish in Stickman Bridge while collecting characters along the track. You need to reach the end ahead of your opponents, so steer your route toward the people you can gather as the race continues. Use the mouse to control your run and compete for first place.

pages.title: Bunny Graduation Double
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description:
Guide a purple bunny and a blue bunny out of a forest that is turning white with snow in Bunny Graduation Double. Bring them to the guard waiting at the end of each level to move on through the escape.

Use WASD for the purple rabbit and the arrow keys for the blue rabbit. Both have a double jump available, giving you another jump while crossing the level.

pages.title: Fantastic Peaman Adventure
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description:
Explore three worlds and complete 30 missions in Fantastic Peaman Adventure. Gather peanuts as you travel through the maps and throw them at enemies to clear your way. Gold can buy additional characters or potions that restore life.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, press F to throw a peanut, and press W or the up arrow twice in succession to double jump. Your collected ammunition and movement both matter as you work through the adventure.

pages.title: ABC ANIMAL
pages.creator: nau.kids
pages.description: Practice animal names in ABC ANIMAL, a learning game from Nau.kids. Examine the choices in each task and drag the correct option into its place. The activity uses selection and matching to connect the animal with the right answer, letting you work through the names one task at a time.

pages.title: 1010 Jungle Blocks
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Fit groups of blocks onto the board in 1010 Jungle Blocks. A complete row or column of ten blocks disappears, opening space for more pieces. Removing more blocks in one move earns a larger score, so look for placements that can complete several lines together.

The game continues while you can still fit the available block sets. Use the mouse or touchpad to place them, keeping enough open space for the shapes that remain.

pages.title: Drunken Tug War
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Pull your opponent toward the hazardous center in Drunken Tug War. Repeated key presses tug the rope, while contact with the green radioactive area reduces a player's health. Win the struggle to score, and be the first to reach five points to take the match.

Choose the one-player or two-player mode. Player one pulls with W, and player two uses the up arrow, making the contest a test of rapid, sustained tapping.

pages.title: Hidden Objects My Brother's Fortune
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description:
Follow Jennifer into a South American jungle in Hidden Objects My Brother's Fortune. A letter from her missing brother says he has found treasure and needs her help, setting up a search for both him and the truth behind his discovery.

Each scene gives you a list of objects on the left. Locate them before the timer expires, use a hint if you get stuck, and select the magnifying glass to zoom in. You can drag the enlarged scene around to inspect details.

pages.title: Mees Kees Stacker
pages.creator: WPG Kindermedia
pages.description: Build an unlikely tower in Mees Kees Stacker using classroom objects and other items. Blocks, bags, and even bowling balls need to sit on top of one another without tumbling down. The challenge is to stack everything while keeping the growing pile stable, taking the different shapes into account with each placement.

pages.title: Love Dots
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Bring two separated balls together in Love Dots by drawing lines or shapes on the screen. Your drawing supplies the extra pieces needed to make the balls meet in the same place and complete the stage. Look at their starting positions and the space between them, then work out what shape could connect their paths.

pages.title: Laser Overload
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description:
Aim a bouncing ball through geometric targets in Laser Overload. Choose a direction that lets the shot rebound between shapes and reach the white figures you need to clear. The layout turns each shot into an angle puzzle, asking you to consider the ball's path beyond its first collision.

Hold to aim and release to shoot. Adjust your direction to find a route through the remaining targets.

pages.title: Social Blackjack
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Take a seat at a shared card table in Social Blackjack and play your hand against the dealer. Choose a wager, request another card with Hit, or use Stand when you want to keep your hand. Your goal is to beat the dealer without going bust.

The table also offers Double, Split, and Surrender decisions. Its rules require the dealer to draw through 16 and stand on every 17, giving you a fixed dealer rule to consider when choosing your own action.

pages.title: Dino Color
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Match pieces by color in Dino Color, a learning puzzle from Nau.kids. Look at the dinosaur's color and connect it with the matching piece to complete the task. The activity focuses on recognizing colors and pairing the correct pieces, using dinosaurs as the subject of each comparison.

pages.title: Control
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Keep two balls under control in Control, an arcade balancing game. Move the bumper left or right to return the bouncing ball above it while also keeping the lower ball centered. Moving to catch one ball can affect your handling of the other, so watch both parts of the screen. Tap the left or right side to adjust your position and keep earning points from returns.

pages.title: Kindergarten Coloring
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Color school-themed pictures in Kindergarten Coloring. The subjects include a school bus, books, and a bag, giving you familiar classroom items to paint in your chosen colors. Use the mouse to work on the pictures and decide how each item should look, creating your own version of the school illustrations.

pages.title: Bullet Master
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Clear every enemy from the screen in Bullet Master, a two-dimensional shooting game with 40 levels. Use the tap controls to attack the targets and work through each stage's enemy arrangement. Completing a level means eliminating the opposition, then taking on the next setup as you progress through the set of shooting challenges.

pages.title: Cricket 2020
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Take the crease as your team's last remaining batter in Cricket 2020. Tap to play a shot and score as many runs as you can before the final wicket is lost. With nobody left behind you in the batting order, the innings depends on your shots and the timing of each hit.

pages.title: US Army Drone Attack
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description: Attack enemy bases in US Army Drone Attack, a military-vehicle action game built around combat missions and missile strikes. Control the vehicles and drone, line up attacks on the assigned targets, and work to complete the mission quickly. Use the keyboard arrows for vehicle control and the additional action buttons for the other functions.

pages.title: Monster Busters : Match 3 Puzzle
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Clear escaped mutant frogs and monsters in Monster Busters : Match 3 Puzzle by connecting them into matching chains. Check the objective before you start: some levels require a target score, while others ask you to remove slime from particular spaces on the board. Use the left mouse button to form your connections and work toward the current level's goal.

pages.title: Rise of Speed
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Race sports cars over off-road courses in Rise of Speed. Winning earns rewards that you can spend in the garage on vehicle modifications or additional cars. Better vehicles and further earnings are needed to enter later races, so each victory supports your progress through the competition.

Drive with the arrow keys or WASD, use Space to brake, and press N for nitro. Choose when to use your boost as you tackle the track.

pages.title: BTS Spring Time Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Add your own colors to spring-themed illustrations in BTS Spring Time Coloring Book. The pictures draw on the season's flowers, rain, and warmer weather, letting you choose how the scenes should look. Select a picture and use the mouse or touch controls to color it, building a spring palette of your own.

pages.title: Vintage Cars Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble pictures of classic vehicles in Vintage Cars Slide. Choose from three car images and three puzzle modes, then slide the separated sections into the arrangement that restores the picture. Use the mouse to move the pieces, checking the car's details and the surrounding image as you work out where each section belongs.

pages.title: On Air Monster Truck Race
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Drive a monster truck through a three-dimensional racing challenge in On Air Monster Truck Race. Choose a truck, tackle the course, and race for victory to earn prize money. Those winnings can unlock other monster trucks, giving you additional vehicles to use in later races. Control your truck with WASD or the arrow keys as you work toward a winning finish.

pages.title: Lof Snakes and Ladders
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Roll the die and race along the board in Lof Snakes and Ladders. Each roll moves your token forward, but landing on a ladder sends you higher while a snake takes you back down. The first player to reach the end wins.

Play against the computer or choose hotseat play with a friend on the same device. Click or tap the die when it is your turn and see where the roll takes you.

pages.title: Tetrix
pages.creator: xGAMES
pages.description:
Stack falling shapes and complete rows in Tetrix, a block puzzle with a Matrix-inspired appearance. Fit pieces together to remove full lines, build your score, and preserve room for the next shape. If a new piece cannot be placed, the game ends.

Move with the left and right arrows, use Down to lower a piece, and press Up to rotate it. Space drops the current shape into place.

pages.title: Foot Treatment
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Help patients with sore feet in Foot Treatment, a medical-care simulation controlled with the mouse. Work through the treatment tasks using the tools provided, tending to each person's feet before completing the final nail-care stage. The game takes you through both parts of the visit, from the foot treatment to the finishing work on the nails.

pages.title: Arkadium's Mahjongg Dimensions Blue
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description:
Turn a three-dimensional tile structure and search for matching symbols in Arkadium's Mahjongg Dimensions Blue. Select two available cubes with the same design to remove the pair, then look for new matches among the pieces you have exposed. Only uncovered, unblocked cubes can be selected.

Rotate the structure to inspect it from another side when a match is difficult to see. The clock keeps the puzzle moving, so clear pairs quickly while checking which cubes are available.

pages.title: Santa Gift Adventure
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Help Santa gather Christmas presents in Santa Gift Adventure. Snow yetis are keeping the gifts for themselves, so guide Santa through the adventure and collect presents while staying clear of them. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to move through the task and recover gifts for the children.

pages.title: Little Monster Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Make rows of matching creatures in Little Monster Match 3. Arrange three or more identical monster blocks together to score points, and keep an eye on the scale along the left edge of the screen. If it drops too low, the game ends. Click or tap to make matches and keep the run going while working toward a higher score.

pages.title: Fire Clans Clash
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Send soldiers into combat in Fire Clans Clash and use the gold from battle to improve their skills. Touch the screen to dispatch your army, then invest the rewards in a stronger force for the continuing war. The main cycle links your battlefield attacks with upgrading the soldiers you send into the next fight.

pages.title: Christmas Art 2019 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put festive artwork back together in Christmas Art 2019 Slide. There are three Christmas images to choose from, each available with three puzzle modes. Move the picture sections with the mouse and rearrange them until the original scene is restored. Compare neighboring parts of the artwork to work out how the sliding pieces should fit.

pages.title: Ninja Clan
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Time the ninja's jumps in Ninja Clan to collect fruit without hitting the weapons in the way. Press or tap to control each jump, watching both the collectible fruit and the hazards as you move. The task combines gathering fruit with keeping your ninja clear of the dangerous objects.

pages.title: My Christmas Items
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Remember the positions of festive pictures in My Christmas Items. Flip two tiles at a time and find matching pairs, continuing until every tile has been paired. Try to finish with as few moves as possible by keeping track of the images you have already uncovered.

The memory game has four levels. Click a tile with the mouse or tap it on the screen to reveal the picture underneath.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Thanksgiving Day
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Baby Hazel prepare for a Thanksgiving visit from her grandparents in Baby Hazel Thanksgiving Day. She has several chores to finish before the family dinner, and your role is to assist with the preparations. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and help her complete the tasks as the celebration approaches.

pages.title: Thanks Giving Turkey Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore a Thanksgiving turkey picture in Thanks Giving Turkey Slide. Select one of the three images and choose among the three available modes, then use the mouse to slide the sections into position. Work toward a complete picture by matching the turkey's features and the surrounding details across the pieces.

pages.title: Color Spin
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Keep a ball bouncing inside a colored ring in Color Spin. Turn the wheel left or right so the section at the bottom matches the ball's color when it lands. Each bounce requires another correctly aligned color, so watch the ball while adjusting the ring. Use one or two fingers to rotate the wheel and try to sustain the longest run you can.

pages.title: Potato Chips Maker
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Follow potatoes from the ground to a finished snack in Potato Chips Maker. Dig up potatoes, wash and peel them, then slice them for the fryer. Continue through the preparation stages to cook the chips and put them into bags.

Use the mouse to handle the tools and ingredients as you work through the process. The activity finishes with preparing the packaged chips for the shelves.

pages.title: FatBoy Dream
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Jump between giant doughnuts in FatBoy Dream, an arcade adventure set inside a boy's food-filled dream. Use the mouse to control the action, land on the next doughnut, and collect the other sweets along the way. Avoid falling between the doughnuts as you continue moving through the dream.

pages.title: Zombie X City Apocalypse
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Fight through a city overrun by a failed experiment in Zombie X City Apocalypse. Shoot the zombies blocking your path and use the available equipment to stay alive through the outbreak. You can slow time, activate armor, or throw a grenade when the fight calls for them.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys and jump with Space. The mouse buttons fire and aim, R reloads, and the mouse wheel changes weapons. Press T to slow time, G for a grenade, F for the flashlight, and C for armor.

pages.title: BTS Cake Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a cake picture and give it your own colors in BTS Cake Coloring Book. The game offers a selection of images to paint, with mouse or touch controls for working on your chosen illustration. Decide how you want the cake to look and add colors to create your own version of the picture.

pages.title: Zombie Survival Shooter
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Take on zombies and infected dogs in Zombie Survival Shooter, a combat game set in city streets. Work through the missions and clear the undead threatening the city, using an arsenal that includes pistols, rifles, shotguns, a machine gun, and grenades.

Armor and grenade options provide additional equipment for the fights, and several city maps give you different locations to defend. Choose your weapons and eliminate the attackers to complete the missions.

pages.title: Boeing Flight Simulator 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Take an aircraft from the ground into the air and bring it back down in Boeing Flight Simulator 3D. The game follows the main parts of a flight, letting you control the plane's movement along with its acceleration and landing gear.

Use the arrow keys to pilot the aircraft. The mouse operates additional on-screen options, including acceleration and extending or retracting the gear, as you work through takeoff, flight, and landing.

pages.title: Cartoon Farm Animals Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Rebuild animal scenes in Cartoon Farm Animals Puzzle, a jigsaw game with 12 pictures to choose from. Select a picture and a difficulty setting, then put its separated pieces together to restore the original farm illustration. Low, Medium, and High settings offer different challenges.

There is no time limit, so you can inspect the pieces and work at your own pace. Use the mouse or touch controls to complete the picture.

pages.title: Ear Doctor
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Treat a series of cartoon patients in Ear Doctor, a medical-care game controlled with the mouse. Choose a character and work through the ear-care tasks, using the instruments provided as the view moves in for treatment. Complete the tool activities to progress through the patient's visit and finish the care routine.

pages.title: Cartoon Farm Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Search illustrated farm scenes for concealed stars in Cartoon Farm Hidden Stars. Look over the picture carefully and click or tap each star you find, continuing until you have located them all. The objective is to identify the small hidden shapes among the farm's details and finish the search.

pages.title: Ado Cars Drifter 2
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description:
Build a score by sliding your car through turns in Ado Cars Drifter 2. Choose a vehicle, keep it drifting, and earn points from the action. Progress can unlock more cars and maps, while achievements give you further goals beyond a single high score.

Drive with WASD or the arrow keys and use Space to brake. Work on controlling the car's angle as you try to extend your drifts and improve your result.

pages.title: Crazy Racing
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description:
Choose a car and a track in Crazy Racing, then drive through lap-based races. Steer around the course, keep the car on its route, and work toward the finish while the game tracks your progress around the circuit.

The game offers Arcade and Time Trial selections, giving you a choice between race competition and a timed run. Pick a course and work on getting through its bends efficiently.

pages.title: Love Speed Ball
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Jump between hoops to open doors in Love Speed Ball. Keep the ball moving from one hoop to the next and work toward the highest score you can reach.

pages.title: Princess Rainbow Look
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Emma and Mia put together colorful outfits in Princess Rainbow Look. Both princesses want to try a rainbow-inspired style, and you choose the clothes they will wear for the occasion. Explore the available dress-up choices and decide which combinations best suit each girl's version of the rainbow theme.

pages.title: Fruit Snake
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Keep a snake moving toward food in Fruit Snake. Collecting fruit adds time, so each successful pickup helps you continue the run and work toward a higher score. Guide the snake from one fruit to the next while watching the remaining time, balancing your route with the need to keep collecting.

pages.title: Orange
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Time a squeeze of fruit juice in Orange so the drop falls into the glass below. Tap the screen to release the juice, watching the fruit and glass before choosing your moment. Successful drops add to your score, making the challenge one of repeating accurate squeezes rather than simply tapping as quickly as possible.

pages.title: Drone Pickup Service
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Pilot a delivery drone to a package and bring it back to base in Drone Pickup Service. Trees, hills, vehicles, aircraft, and windmills make the collection route difficult, so navigate around the obstacles on both parts of the trip.

Completing the pickup is only part of the challenge: your finishing time affects the result. Work toward a faster delivery to earn a three-star rating for the task.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Sunsets
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Assemble 16 sunset pictures in Jigsaw Puzzle Sunsets. Put the separated pieces together to recreate each scene, using the colors of the evening sky and the image's other details to find where they belong. Choose a picture and work through its pieces until the view is complete.

pages.title: Outfit Competition
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare six models for fashion-cover photographs in Outfit Competition. Your role is to put together their looks for the shoot, choosing how each model will appear in the finished lineup. Work through the models and create outfits suited to their turn in front of the camera.

pages.title: Paper Plane : The Crazy Lab
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Guide a shape-changing paper creation out of a laboratory in Paper Plane : The Crazy Lab. You play the origami experiment trying to escape its creators, moving past the obstacles that stand between it and freedom. Work through the lab's hazards and use its changing forms to continue the escape.

pages.title: Princesses at Met Gala Ball
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Style Snow White, Belle, and Cinderella for a red-carpet appearance in Princesses at Met Gala Ball. You are the designer preparing all three princesses for the art and fashion event, choosing the looks they will wear on the gala stairs. Give each guest a finished outfit for her turn at the ball.

pages.title: Preco v.2
pages.creator: Xpresate Studio
pages.description:
Guide a robot and a child through a hazardous adventure in Preco v.2. In the first part, move the robot left or right to gather hearts. You need a full reserve before reaching the transition to the child's part of the journey.

The collected hearts then become a resource to protect: bats and other hazards can take them away. Use the on-screen direction controls to steer through the route and keep enough hearts to make it to the end.

pages.title: Desert Skeet
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Aim at flying clay targets in Desert Skeet and shoot them before they leave your sights. The game has four stages of target shooting, with your score reflecting the skeets you hit along the way. Watch the targets' movement and place your shots carefully as you work through the stages.

pages.title: Anna Mermaid Vs Princess
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create two different versions of the same character in Anna Mermaid Vs Princess. Dress her as a mermaid and as a princess, preparing each look for a special occasion. Once both outfits are ready, compare the results and decide which version you prefer. The focus is on styling the two contrasting appearances.

pages.title: Ice Queen Shopping Xmas Gift
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Earn money and choose Christmas presents in Ice Queen Shopping Xmas Gift. Help the queen work and collect the bills she earns, then take her to the shop to buy gifts for her friends. Your shopping budget depends on how much money you have gathered.

If the total is too small for the things you want, return to work and earn more. Tap to interact as you move between earning and shopping.

pages.title: Nectar Harvest
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Send a bee across the flower field in Nectar Harvest. Drag the bee to set up your move, then release it to clear flowers along its route. You need to clear the whole field while watching for enemies nearby, making both the direction of the launch and the surrounding hazards worth checking before you let go.

pages.title: Space Jack
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Collect every star across 15 levels in Space Jack, an arcade game inspired by Bomb Jack. Move through each stage while keeping clear of enemies and gathering the stars needed to finish it. Picking stars up in the intended order earns extra points, adding a scoring challenge to the collection task. Play using the keyboard or touch controls.

pages.title: Fitness Workout XL
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Help two friends maintain their gym routine in Fitness Workout XL. Work through exercise activities such as cycling, presses, and pull-ups, while also managing their need for food and rest. Training alone is not enough: you need sufficient food and relaxation before starting another workout.

Move between the gym, eating, and resting activities to keep the routine going. The exercise tasks and recovery requirements make the game a small fitness-management challenge.

pages.title: Crusader Defense
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Build a line of medieval defenders in Crusader Defense to stop incoming enemy waves. Select positions for archers, knights, and pikemen, using your available money to buy the units you can afford. Different defenders have their own attack range and damage, so their placement affects how they cover the route.

Keep the attackers from exhausting your remaining lives. Select a defensive position, choose a unit, and strengthen the line as the waves approach.

pages.title: Beaver Bubbles
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Help the beavers clear a field of colored balls in Beaver Bubbles. Aim a shot at matching colors and connect a group of at least three to remove it. Clearing supporting balls can also release groups that are no longer attached to the top of the field.

Use the mouse or touch controls to aim and shoot. Keep the remaining balls from reaching the bottom while working toward a cleared board.

pages.title: Anna And Elsa Arendelle Ball
pages.creator: Bitent Media
pages.description: Get the sisters ready for a royal celebration in Anna And Elsa Arendelle Ball. Anna is hosting the event, and you help choose an elegant gown for her while preparing the sisters' ball looks. Put together their outfits for an evening of dressing up and dancing in Arendelle.

pages.title: Ice Queen Pregnant Fashion
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Choose a holiday-party look for an expectant Elsa in Ice Queen Pregnant Fashion. Help her adapt her wardrobe by selecting an outfit for the celebration, then choose makeup to complete the style. The dress-up task centers on putting those choices together into an elegant festive appearance that suits her pregnancy.

pages.title: Princess Birthday Party
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Dress three princesses for a celebration in Princess Birthday Party. Combine a top with the lower part of a dress, choose shoes, and try a different hairstyle to build each girl's look. Add a bouquet of flowers to finish the outfit, then prepare the next princess for the birthday gathering.

pages.title: Halloween Witch Dress!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose a costume for a princess's first Halloween in Halloween Witch Dress! Help her find the dress she will wear for the celebration and put together a witch-inspired look from the available choices. The task is to decide how she should appear for her first turn at the Halloween festivities.

pages.title: Bathing Spa Pregnant Queen
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description:
Give an expectant queen a spa visit and a new look in Bathing Spa Pregnant Queen. Begin with facial treatments and a massage, then move on to the styling stages once her spa session is complete.

Apply makeup, choose a dress, and select a hairstyle and accessories to finish her appearance. The game follows the visit from the care routine through to putting together her final outfit.

pages.title: Jumping Box
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description:
Charge a jump and send a box between narrow platforms in Jumping Box. Hold the screen to build power, then release to leap toward the next landing place. The platforms vary in width and spacing, so the amount of charge needs to fit the gap.

Landing on a new platform adds to your score. Keep adjusting the jump strength to reach the next one, and avoid falling below the platforms.
